# Configuration

The RM 8.5 lag always uses the last available observation from
`rm_8_5_historical` until a real-time sensor is installed.

```{r config}
# ── Lead days to forecast ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lead_days_vec <- c(1, 3, 7)

# ── Station / gridpoint ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
owrd_station  <- "14076100"    # Camp Polk
nws_gridpoint <- "PDT/35,57"  # RM 8.5 area; verify at:
# https://api.weather.gov/points/44.390278,-121.406792

# ── Saved model paths (keyed by lead day) ────────────────────────────────────
tmax_model_paths <- setNames(
  lapply(lead_days_vec, \(k) here::here("output", paste0("rm85_rf_tmax_lead", k, ".rds"))),
  paste0("lead_", lead_days_vec)
)
dadm_model_paths <- setNames(
  lapply(lead_days_vec, \(k) here::here("output", paste0("rm85_rf_7dadm_lead", k, ".rds"))),
  paste0("lead_", lead_days_vec)
)

# ── Regulatory thresholds (°C) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
threshold_7dadm <- 17.8 # ODEQ
threshold_tmax  <- 20.0 # HCP
```

---

# 1. Camp Polk Hydrology

Pull instantaneous flow and temperature for the
last 10 days — enough to compute 7DADM and one day of lag.

TODO: need to think through when this data pull occurs to get the most representative "TODAY" values when we aggregate to mean flow and max temperature

```{r owrd-pull}
pull_start <- Sys.Date() - 10
pull_end   <- Sys.Date()

# ── Live OWRD pull ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cp_flow_raw <- get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = owrd_station,
  start_date  = pull_start,
  end_date    = pull_end,
  data_source = "Instantaneous_Flow"
)

cp_tmax_raw <- get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = owrd_station,
  start_date  = pull_start,
  end_date    = pull_end,
  data_source = "WTEMP15"
) 

```

```{r owrd-inspect, results='hold'}
# Inspect raw column names — update the rename() calls below if yours differ
cat("Flow columns:  ", paste(names(cp_flow_raw), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Temp columns:  ", paste(names(cp_tmax_raw), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r owrd-clean}
cp_flow <- cp_flow_raw |> 
  mutate(date = as.Date(
    parse_date_time(record_date, orders = c("mdy", "mdy HM"))
  )) |> 
  group_by(date) |> 
  summarise(cp_flow_mean = mean(instananteous_flow_cfs)) |> 
  select(date, cp_flow_mean) |>
  arrange(date)

cp_tmax <- cp_tmax_raw |> 
  mutate(date = as.Date(
    parse_date_time(record_date, orders = c("mdy", "mdy HM"))
  )) |> 
  group_by(date) |> 
  summarise(cp_tmax = max(instantaneous_water_temp_c)) |> 
  select(date, cp_tmax) |>
  arrange(date)

# Compute 7DADM as 7-day rolling mean of daily max temperature
cp_7dadm <- cp_tmax |>
  mutate(cp_7dadm = rollmean(cp_tmax, k = 7, fill = NA, align = "right"))

# Today's and yesterday's rows (used as lag predictors across all lead models)
cp_today <- cp_flow |>
  filter(date == Sys.Date()) |>
  left_join(cp_tmax, by = "date") |>
  left_join(cp_7dadm |> select(date, cp_7dadm), by = "date")

cp_yest <- cp_flow |>
  filter(date == Sys.Date() - 1) |>
  left_join(cp_tmax, by = "date") |>
  left_join(cp_7dadm |> select(date, cp_7dadm), by = "date")
```

```{r owrd-plot, fig.height=3}
cp_tmax |>
  left_join(cp_7dadm |> select(date, cp_7dadm), by = "date") |>
  pivot_longer(c(cp_tmax, cp_7dadm), names_to = "metric", values_to = "temp_c") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = temp_c, color = metric)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(cp_tmax = "#C93312", cp_7dadm = "#185FA5"),
                     labels = c(cp_tmax = "Daily Max", cp_7dadm = "7DADM")) +
  labs(title = "Camp Polk Water Temperature (recent)", x = NULL,
       y = "Temperature (°C)", color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

---

# 2. NWS Air Temperature & Cloud Cover

Fetch max air temperature, min air temperature, and sky cover for the full
forecast window. Results from `get_nws_forecast()` have columns:
`datetime`, `value`, `duration`, `variable`. A single pull covers all three
lead days (NWS returns a rolling 7-day window).

```{r nws-pull}
# ── Live NWS pull ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
nws_tmax  <- get_nws_forecast(nws_gridpoint, "maxTemperature")
nws_tmin  <- get_nws_forecast(nws_gridpoint, "minTemperature")
nws_cloud <- get_nws_forecast(nws_gridpoint, "skyCover")
```

```{r nws-helper}
# Helper: collapse hourly/sub-daily NWS values to one number per calendar day
daily_nws <- function(df, target_date, agg_fn = mean) {
  df |>
    mutate(date = as.Date(datetime)) |>
    filter(date == target_date) |>
    summarise(value = agg_fn(value, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    pull(value)
}
```

---

# 3. RM 8.5 Previous-Day Temperature (Dummy Lag)

The lagged RM 8.5 temperature (`Tmax_m1` / `dadm_m1`) is the most important
predictor in both models. Until a real-time sensor is online, use the last
available observation from `rm_8_5_historical`. The same lag value is used
across all lead days — this is an approximation for leads > 1 day.

```{r rm85-lag}
rm85_last_tmax <- rm_8_5_historical |>
  filter(statistic == "max") |>
  filter(month(date) == month(Sys.Date()),
         day(date)   == day(Sys.Date())) |> 
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
  arrange(desc(date)) |>
  slice(1)

rm85_last_dadm <- rm_8_5_historical |>
  filter(statistic == "7DADM") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
  filter(month(date) == month(Sys.Date()),
         day(date)   == day(Sys.Date())) |> 
  arrange(desc(date)) |>
  slice(1)

Tmax_m1 <- rm85_last_tmax$temperature
dadm_m1 <- rm85_last_dadm$temperature

cat(sprintf(
  "RM 8.5 lag source: last historical observation\n  Tmax_m1 = %.2f °C  (from %s)\n  dadm_m1 = %.2f °C  (from %s)\n",
  Tmax_m1, rm85_last_tmax$date,
  dadm_m1, rm85_last_dadm$date
))
```

> **When a real-time sensor is installed:** replace this chunk with a live
> `get_8_5_realtime` call for the RM 8.5.
> No other changes to the pipeline are needed.

---

# 4. Predict Across All Lead Days

For each lead day the model uses:

- **NWS air temp / cloud:** the k-day-ahead forecast for the valid date and
the day before (from the single NWS pull above)
- **Camp Polk flow/temp:** today's and yesterday's observed values — used as
the lag predictors for all leads (approximation for leads > 1; future Camp
Polk conditions are unknown)
- **RM 8.5 lag:** the last available observation (same across all leads)

```{r predict-all-leads}
results_list <- map(lead_days_vec, function(k) {
  fdate    <- Sys.Date() + k
  lead_key <- paste0("lead_", k)
  
  # NWS values for this lead's valid date and the day before
  air_max_k    <- daily_nws(nws_tmax,  fdate,     max)
  air_min_k    <- daily_nws(nws_tmin,  fdate,     min)
  cloud_k      <- daily_nws(nws_cloud, fdate,     mean)
  air_max_m1_k <- daily_nws(nws_tmax,  fdate - 1, max)
  air_min_m1_k <- daily_nws(nws_tmin,  fdate - 1, min)
  
  # ── Tmax model features (Section C) ──────────────────────────────────────
  feat_tmax <- data.frame(
    cp_flow_mean = cp_today$cp_flow_mean,
    cp_tmax      = cp_today$cp_tmax,
    Julian       = yday(fdate),
    air_max      = air_max_k,
    air_min      = air_min_k,
    cloud_pct    = cloud_k,
    cp_flow_m1   = cp_yest$cp_flow_mean,
    cp_tmax_m1   = cp_yest$cp_tmax,
    air_max_m1   = air_max_m1_k,
    air_min_m1   = air_min_m1_k,
    Tmax_m1      = Tmax_m1
  ) 
  
  # ── 7DADM model features (Section F) ─────────────────────────────────────
  feat_7dadm <- data.frame(
    cp_flow_mean = cp_today$cp_flow_mean,
    cp_7dadm     = cp_today$cp_7dadm,
    Julian       = yday(fdate),
    air_max      = air_max_k,
    air_min      = air_min_k,
    cloud_pct    = cloud_k,
    cp_flow_m1   = cp_yest$cp_flow_mean,
    cp_7dadm_m1  = cp_yest$cp_7dadm,
    air_max_m1   = air_max_m1_k,
    air_min_m1   = air_min_m1_k,
    dadm_m1      = dadm_m1
  ) 
  
  rf_tmax  <- readRDS(tmax_model_paths[[lead_key]])
  rf_7dadm <- readRDS(dadm_model_paths[[lead_key]])
  
  tibble(
    lead_day     = k,
    forecast_date = fdate,
    pred_tmax_C  = round(predict(rf_tmax,  feat_tmax),  2),
    pred_7dadm_C = round(predict(rf_7dadm, feat_7dadm), 2)
  )
})

results <- bind_rows(results_list) |>
  mutate(
    exceed_tmax  = pred_tmax_C  > threshold_tmax,
    exceed_7dadm = pred_7dadm_C > threshold_7dadm,
    rm85_lag_source = paste0("last obs (", rm85_last_tmax$date, ")")
  )
```

---

# 5. Results

```{r results-table}
knitr::kable(
  results |> select(lead_day, forecast_date, pred_tmax_C, pred_7dadm_C,
                    exceed_tmax, exceed_7dadm),
  col.names = c("Lead (days)", "Forecast Date",
                "Pred Tmax (°C)", "Pred 7DADM (°C)",
                paste0("Tmax > ", threshold_tmax, " °C"),
                paste0("7DADM > ", threshold_7dadm, " °C")),
  align = "clcccc"
)
```

```{r results-plot, fig.height=4}
results |>
  select(lead_day, forecast_date, pred_tmax_C, pred_7dadm_C) |>
  pivot_longer(c(pred_tmax_C, pred_7dadm_C),
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "temp_c") |>
  mutate(
    metric    = recode(metric, pred_tmax_C = "Daily Max (Tmax)",
                       pred_7dadm_C = "7-Day Avg Daily Max (7DADM)"),
    threshold = if_else(metric == "Daily Max (Tmax)", threshold_tmax, threshold_7dadm)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = forecast_date, y = temp_c)) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = threshold), linetype = "dashed",
             color = "#C93312", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = "#185FA5", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = factor(lead_day)), color = "#185FA5", size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", temp_c)),
            vjust = -0.8, size = 3.2, color = "#333333") +
  facet_wrap(~metric, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("1" = 16, "3" = 17, "7" = 15),
                     name = "Lead (days)") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d", breaks = results$forecast_date) +
  labs(title = paste("RM 8.5 Temperature Forecast — issued", Sys.Date()),
       x = "Forecast Date", y = "Temperature (°C)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
